neighbours.label: the idiom 'keep/bear (this) in mind' and 'with X in mind': fires on 'in' and its object
fire: When you choose a tent, keep the weather in mind as well as the weight.
Bear that in mind before you sign any contract with them.
The course was designed with working parents in mind.
Please keep these rules in mind during the field trip.
Investors should bear in mind that past returns are no guarantee.
We built the app with older users in mind, so the buttons are large.
It's worth keeping this in mind when the bill arrives.
Always keep your budget in mind when you shop for furniture.
quiet: When you choose a tent, keep the poles in the bag as well as the pegs.
Bear that weight carefully before you lift it onto the truck.
The course was designed for working parents in the evening.
Please keep these forms in the folder during the field trip.
Investors should remember that past returns are no guarantee.
We built the app for older users, so the buttons are large.
It's worth keeping this receipt in your wallet when the bill arrives.
Always keep your receipt in the drawer when you shop for furniture.
